modules.name: Thunder
modules.description: Drum voice in the Perkons style: 15 algorithms with A/B MORPH, multimode filter, overdrive and bucket-brigade delay, two learnable CV inputs, WEAR and MUTATE for hits that never repeat exactly, 8 memories

modules.name: Lightning
modules.description: Four-slot hit catcher for Thunder: KEEP grabs the last whole hit already trimmed, SEND puts its knob settings back on Thunder; also takes any audio on IN. Per-slot TUNE, DECAY, LEVEL, 4 outs + MIX, sounds saved in the patch
